params.body:
Four items from today's feedback, one PR.

## 1. Sold vehicles: most recently sold on top (Frederik)
After making an order the vehicle landed "somewhere at the bottom" of the sold vehicles. The own-stock list kept `created_at desc` even with sold vehicles shown. Now, with the sold toggle on and no explicit sort, the order is `COALESCE(vehicles.sold_at, vehicles.created_at) desc`: the last sold vehicle is first, unsold vehicles keep their place by date added. A chosen sort still wins; without the toggle nothing changes. `VehicleRepository::getOwnStockList`, rule P1-1.6, finding `2026-09-15-verkochte-wagens-laatst-verkocht-bovenaan.md` (open question for Frederik: a separate sold tab, or is this enough?).

## 2. Mijn aangeboden wagens on a phone
The phone got the generic label:value card of the table row (thirteen cells, thumbnail in the corner, six icon buttons). New `export/_card.blade.php`, shown under 768 px instead of the rows: photo full width at 16:9 (car icon fallback), "Toyota RAV4 (2003)" as title, a status badge (open / gesloten / toegewezen from `isBiddingOpen()` and the winning bid), "Hoogste bod € 1 800,00 door Autohandel Verstraete" or "Nog geen bod", "Loopt tot dd/mm/jjjj" or "Gesloten op …", a quiet meta line (type bieding, eigenaar), the counters behind a native `<details>` "Details", "Bekijk biedingen" as the visible button and the other actions (toon aan klant, print overeenkomst, print borderel, kopiëren, aanpassen, verwijderen) in a ⋯ bottom sheet (`ui-menu--sheet`). Documents-only vehicles (R B1-1.14) get no status/bid/counters and "Toon aan klant" as the button. The filter row stays as the panel behind Filteren. New rule B1-1.17.

**Desktop too** (Shane: "deze tabel is nog veel te breed"; at 1440 the fourteen columns ran 2023 px wide in nl and 2168 px in fr inside a 1340 px card). New `export/_row.blade.php` with six cells: Wagen (thumb, "Toyota RAV4 (2003)", type bieding as a quiet second line), Bod (amount with the bidder under it, or "Nog geen bod"), Looptijd (status badge, "13/09/2026 tot 20/09/2026"), Originele eigenaar, Details (mailed and the three counters behind a `<details>` expander, a red badge when the control counter is at zero) and actions ("Biedingen" button + ⋯ menu). Filters keep every field, grouped under their column with the column name as placeholder. Table width now 1340/1340 at 1440 and no overflow at 1280 (measured in the screenshot run); the wrapper no longer clips so the ⋯ menu can hang below. `ExportVehicle::status()` (assigned / open / closed) feeds both row and card. The toolbar labels "Sorteer op" / "Filteren" were hard-coded Dutch and now use `ui.sort_by` / `ui.filter` (fr: Trier par / Filtrer). Translations in nl/fr/en/de/es `ui.php`.

## 3. Leads worklist: two clear buttons
"Bekijk op de website" and "Bekijk op Stocklist Dealer" were `btn btn-primary` and rendered as faint grey text. Now two `ui-button`s with an icon in a `ui-lead-links` row, full width and 44 px on a phone. Rule P1-3.12 extended.

## 4. Bidding detail: damage before Eigenschappen (Shane)
When `stocklist/detail.blade.php` renders a bidding (`$export_vehicle` set) and the vehicle has visible damage, the damage section comes right after the core specs and before Eigenschappen. The normal Stocklist detail keeps damage after the extras. Rule B1-2.12, finding `2026-09-15-schadeplan-eerst-bij-bieding.md` (Shane decides whether it should go above the core specs as well).

## Tests
- `OwnStockListTest::test_with_sold_vehicles_shown_the_most_recently_sold_is_on_top`
- `ExportListPhoneCardTest` (open with bid, closed without bid, assigned, documents only)
- `WorklistPageTest::test_the_links_under_a_lead_are_two_buttons_with_an_icon`
- `BiddingDetailDamageOrderTest` (bidding: damage > options > dates; stocklist: options > dates > damage)

Filter `Export|Bidding|OwnStockList|Worklist|Lead|Stocklist|Damage|StylesheetSyntax|AlpineExpression|HandlerWiring|CompiledViews|RulesCoverage|RulesIdentity`: 169 tests, 1418 assertions, green.

## Screenshots
`.playwright-mcp/bidding-lists/` in the worktree: `exports-before-390.png` / `exports-after-390.png` (+ `-menu`, `-details`), `exports-{before,after}-{nl,fr}-1440.png` (+ `exports-after-nl-1440-open.png` with Details and the ⋯ menu open), `leads-{before,after}-1440.png`, `sold-{before,after}-1440.png`, `bidding-detail-{before,after}-1440.png`.
params.title: Sold list newest first, bidding cards for a phone, clearer lead links, damage first on a bidding
